description: Memory-only test case 1. Tests memory recall with 5 probes. The 8 setup queries run in the test case to build memory, then a session break, then 5 probe queries test memory recall.

steps.user_message: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
Sounds lovely — glad you had a relaxing weekend with Maria. Would you like help turning that into an email, message, or social post? I can draft or send one for you.

Here are a few quick options — tell me which you want or edit any text:

1) Short email to friends
Subject: Weekend in the countryside
Body: Hi everyone — I spent the weekend in the countryside with my sister Maria. We explored nature trails, enjoyed the fresh air, and had a very relaxing time. Highly recommend a short nature escape if you need to recharge. Hope you’re all well!

2) Note to parents
Subject: Quick update — lovely weekend away
Body: Hi Mom and Dad — just wanted to share a quick update. Maria and I took a short trip to the countryside this weekend. We walked several nature trails, breathed lots of fresh air, and had a really peaceful time. I came back feeling refreshed. Love you!

3) Thank-you message to Maria
Body: Hey Maria — thanks for the great weekend! The trail walks and quiet time were exactly what I needed. Let’s do it again soon.

4) Social caption (Instagram/Facebook)
Caption: Countryside weekend with my sister @Maria — trails, fresh air, and total relaxation. Sometimes the best plan is no plan. 🌲☀️

Tell me which one to draft or send, who the recipient should be (email address or platform), and whether to include photos. If you want a different tone or more detail, say so and I’ll adjust.
